_rule: PERMANENT WIRE LEDGER. A code's ID is written into .ffhr streams and decodes them forever. Never renumber an existing code. Never reuse a retired ID. New codes are appended at _next_id. Removing a code from HL7 does NOT free its ID -- old streams still reference it.
_scope: FastFHIR ships code VALUES from HL7 FHIR and UCUM only. Codes from terminologies FastFHIR does not own (SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD, CPT, NDC, EDQM, ...) are never added here -- they travel as FF_CODEABLE_CONCEPT blocks carrying the user's own code, under the user's own license. Enforced by _assert_redistributable().
_provenance: Reset once, deliberately, during early alpha: the previous ledger had absorbed 13,310 LOINC/SNOMED/EDQM-shaped codes from an old value-set expansion. Those were removed and the remaining HL7/UCUM codes renumbered from 1. The append-only rule applies from this point on.
